notes.title: My Liege Bug and Balance Patch #1
notes.content:
Lords and Ladies,

It is I, your liege penguin SugoiPenguin, here with a bug and balance patch for My Liege.  This patch focuses on 3 things:
[olist]
 Fixing Dialogue for improper Old English pronoun usage
 Fixing Achievement logic in weird cases
 Balancing a few fights and decision points to encourage variety in playthroughs
[/olist]
Below are the full patch notes. As always, let me know if you have any feedback, bugs of your own, or in general want to say hi!
-Addison

Bugs

 Fixed soft lock that could occur in Act 4 during the event "Lost Homestead"
 Overworld lights reworked to have less "popping" when they come into view. Most noticeable in the market when going to a quest giver and a light source was barely off screen. 
 Lanterns now glow properly when lit.
 Fixed "Doppelganger" achievement to properly compare names when steam name has special characters in it
 Watermill wheel's animation smoothly spins
 Fixed story related achievement to properly get awarded if you went an alternate route
 Story element where you bet with Lord Carlbridge actually applies the outcome of the bet.
 Updated hats to grow for some hair styles to clip less. It is not perfect, but significantly better than before.
 Epilogue endings fixed to provide right details (spoilers make this super vague... oh well)
 Fight cinematics teleport guards/soldiers to be closer if they are far away, preventing awkward fights where one army is super late.
 Timing of attacks and deaths improved some in a variety of scenes. Hopefully people don't die without being touched.
 No longer can click "Load" more than once from main menu save file list.
 Cinematic dialogue text no longer overflows if you customize characters to have REALLY long names.
 Plague stat now shows red when increasing and green when decreasing.
 Generic NPC quest givers now maintain the same appearance when they appear in scene.


Balance

 Updated stat related achievements (for having 0 or 5 of a stat) to be granted whenever a stat is updated. Previously you had to have 0 or 5 at the start of a new week.
 Gaining trust with the larger houses made easier. Previously it was more difficult than desired to manipulate which house liked you best.


Clean Up

 Fixed Old English words that I used inconsistently, turns out grammar matters. 

 Thou, thee, thy, thine, hast for example
 Fixed Old English contractions to be actual contractions.

 Tis -> 'Tis, Twere -> 'Twere, Twas -> 'Twas
 Reworded sections where the narration referred to your character in third person weirdly.
 Simplified wording in spots where it was too painfully Old English.
 Focused meeple and horse cams in menu updated to view them from the front, not the back. 

 No more zoomed in horse butt cameras (sorry not sorry).
 In a handful of scenes removed or relocated items that got TOO in the way of the text.
 Notification icon better, not blurry.
 More places have light sources, especially newly constructed optional buildings.
 Long save file names no longer cause text to fall outside of button.

notes.title: Free Content Update #1 - Pettable Pigs, Opinionated Horses, and a Map
notes.content:
Greetings fans of the Western Valley, SugoiPenguin here with the first content update for My Liege!

This update focuses on items that I wanted to include in the game but just didn't have working or have time to finish when the release date arrived. The big focus is on UI improvements, making the Map and Ancestry menus actually enjoyable to use, and adding in pettable pigs! 

There is not much in here for additional story elements, those items are being bundled together for content update #2 (currently planned for Summer 2025).

Enjoy and if you have any feedback, questions, or ideas to add let me know!
-Addison
aka SugoiPenguin Gaming

Major Items
Pigs

 Pettable
 Live in the new muddy pig pen next to the barn
 Love to snort and munch
 5% chance to spawn "shiny" varieties
Horse Updates
 Can be clicked on to learn their name and what they are thinking
 Now have 5 different colorations
 Ser Godfrey arrives on horseback now, more plans in the works to utilize horses more in cinematics and simulated meeples 
Map

 Brand new menu (previously button labeled as coming soon)
 Map is hand drawn rendition of the Western Valley
 Includes labels for each noble house and their stronghold, reflecting custom names
 Complete with flavor text about the maps origins and your stewards review
Ancestry Menu

 Visually redesigned (previously was the dev's least favorite menu, now I like it :)
 Top section displays the noble houses
 Selecting a house causes top section to hide itself creating almost twice as much space to view the family tree in
 Can bring house list down again to select a different house
 Houses sigil displayed in background of house buttons
 Cursor updated to indicate you can drag the family trees in the menu
Stats UI Display

 Updated Stat UI HUD to more clearly display the current stat value and how it is changing
 When current value and the future value for a stat differ, green/red arrows animated behind icons showing where the stat is trending to
 Tip text added to stats, displaying a numerical amount (ex: "Food 2.4/5.0")
 When a decision impacts stats, the menu displayed summarizing change ("Noble Ledgers") only includes the amount items changed by. Previous version included far too many numbers and was not clear.
House Sigils Expanded

 New sigils to pick from, including: Cat, Dog, Hound, Fish, Flamingo, Fox, Hawk, Hay, Pickaxe, Sword, Tree, and Windmill
 Improved the visual display when picking house color, sigil, and sigil color

Minor Items

 Optional buildings updated to be selectable

 Stables, Inn, Bank, Army Encampment, Windmills
 Each has unique flavor text and will display the job and stat most closely associated with building
 Characters can be rotated by clicking and dragging on them in the character editor. I swear, 80% of the playtesters I watched attempted to do this and it is finally here!
 Reassigning meeples streamlined. Now if you have multiple jobs being reassigned to a job (for example, calling banners and raising an army, it only shows one popup menu with all three jobs included and what the final job count is.
 Font updated in many spots to use a drop shadow and improve depth and readability
 Fixed issue where custom House or Character names were not being used in Matter Titles
 Achievement "Fashion Liege" now triggers properly when conditions are met in the intro's family editor
 Autosave names improved (example, "Autosave - Beginning of Act 1 - The Lordsmount")
 Simplified and reworded a ton of lines of dialogue in Acts 0/1/2 based on streamer feedback

notes.title: My Liege Bug and Balance Patch #1
notes.content:
Lords and Ladies,
It has been a week since launch and I'm happy to report there have been no MAJOR errors or bugs discovered! With that said though, there were minor issues that needed fixing which is what this patch is all about!

My update philosophy for the game now that it is in its launched state will be

 Bug and Balance patches as needed (lightweight and designed to just fix things)
 Content Updates as they are ready (new features, updates to existing items, new story elements, and some bug fixes)


My goal with the Content Updates will be one every 4-6 weeks. I have plans for about 3 Content Updates at least, once I get a clearer picture how realistic it is for me to add things at this point I will publish a better roadmap. For now, I will include planned features below with a rating out of 10 for how confident it will be included in the future.

Thank you and if you have any feedback, feel free to comment here or in the forums :)
-Addison
Chief Executive Penguin at SugoiPenguin Gaming

Patch notes
Bug and Balance Fixes:

 Morale now carries over from one Act to the next (previously it would start every Act at 1.5/5 no matter what)
 Max morale achievement can now be earned (see issue above, turns out getting reset to 1.5 was why nobody could get a high enough Morale score)
 Removed achievement for getting 0/5 Military Strength (impossible to achieve and I did not see a clean way to make it achievable with current story)
 Can no longer skip the Matters/Cinematics at the end of an Act by selecting "Advance to Next Act" early
 The Autosave at the start of Act 3 now properly tracks the events of the previous Act (any existing "start of Act 3" autosaves and any saves created from those saves will still have incorrect people/title assignments)
 The third "Decline" option at the end of the investigation storyline now able to be used actually
 No longer allowed to save a game with no save file name
 Added travelling merchant that shows up when for one reason or another there is nothing of note happening during a week
 Notifications for certain turns are ordered more sensibly (example, tutorial notifications will always be listed first)
 Music now properly resumes after the busiest cinematics
 Job list in the top left now keeps a consistent order for how the jobs display
 Correctly updating the title of certain characters in certain events (I know, vague, but you try writing patch notes for story specific issues!)
 Map button no longer clickable and instead says "Coming Soon"



Planned future Content Updates (NOT INCLUDED IN THIS PATCH)
-Pettable animals
-Map 
-Rework of the Ancestory/Family Tree menu 
-Additional variation added to existing story lines 
-Improve ambient audio
-Improve UI elements
-Steam community items

notes.title: My Liege Available Now
notes.content:
Your liege lord has called the banners! The time has come for thee to lead thy house in My Liege!

My Liege, the choices matter story adventure is now available for download on Steam!  To celebrate the launch and as a thank you to everybody that has been following the development, I am offering a 34% discount for the launch week!

I am immensely proud of the product that I have made, it truly is more than I ever imagined it would be. To all of the people that helped along the way by providing playtesting/bug reports/feedback/ideas/encouragement, I say thank you. I could not have done it without your support.

With that said, I hope you enjoy playing My Liege as much as I enjoyed making it! 
-Addison
Developer and Chief Executive Penguin

notes.title: Patch Notes - 07/01/2024
notes.content:
World Map and Terrain Update

Game map expanded to full size within demo.
Demo only has your territory populated with buildings and activity. Neighboring houses and lands will be populated with towns and buildings in full game.
Trees are now impacted by wind are no longer static
Expanded from 4 tree models to 24
Wheat replaced and is also affected by wind
Wheat no longer has a heavy impact on FPS
Added in grasses that, you guessed it, also are affected by wind
Graphics quality settings updated to work with new tree and grass


-Addison, aka SugoiPenguin, aka Jellybean's dad and Juliet's favorite

notes.title: Patch Notes 06/07/2024
notes.content:
Updates
-Added "reassign specific thoughts" that display as the camera follows a meeple that is switching jobs. These thoughts are in addition to the usual opinions meeples have based on your decisions.
-Remade the reassign menu to be cleaner, use the same icons that the advisor preview does when picking an option and job/inventory banners use, and be better positioned to potentially combine menus in a future update
-Reworked the very first "Welcome" matter, made the intro clearer and made both options have an advisor
-Added in new meeple animations that play when meeples are talking, dismissing or showing disappointment, and celebrating a victory

Bug Fixes
-Fixed a couple of situations where the menus would overlap incorrectly and hide buttons
-Fixed several typos and incorrect usage of quotes
-Fixed issue where a matter givers selection menu would persist until you made a selection. The menu was TOO POWERFUL and needed to be stopped.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Demo Updated (Patch Notes)
notes.content:
The newest version of the My Liege demo is now live! This will be the final major update made to the demo until the game is released (on schedule for Fall 2024).  This version of the demo is now representative of the what I envision the released game to look and play like (I'd describe it as 98% there).

Changes Include:
Decision Menu Overhaul

Includes a visual stage for meeples to play out scenarios on
Speech bubbles for advisors to voice their opinions with
Names of important people and houses are clickable links for you to view
You are visually represented now with a meeple during decisions

Meeple Updates
Character editor added, can now visually change important meeples that are named and on the family trees
Meeples visually can have hair, hats, outfits, and handheld items now
Camera Updates

Controls updated to match industry standards
Holding right click causes camera to rotate around a pivot point in front of camera
Scroll wheel can be used to zoom in and out
Camera movements smoothed out, no longer jerky stop and starts
Camera smoothly pans to important locations, quest givers, and cinematic moments

World Changes

World map expanded by 600%
Cinematic moments added to show major events happening in the world
Decisions are began by selecting a "quest giver" that has an exclamation mark above them
Notifications still exist, but take you to the quest giver instead of opening the menu directly

Family Tree Updated

Menu updated to have 2 sections: 
-The top shows the houses and who is sworn to the high lord
- The bottom shows the family tree of a house you selected 
Can edit house details and person details from this menu still

Settings Support

Supports changing resolution, fullscreen mode, and graphics quality
Sound volumes broken into 4 different categories


And a bunch more stuff that I am probably forgetting.

notes.title: Demo Update for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Noble Lords and Ladies of the land of Steam

I am pleased to announce that I am on schedule to have an updated demo for My Liege ready in time for this June's Steam Next Fest! The updated demo will have in it nearly every gameplay element I have planned for My Liege, with all new features including:

 Overhauled event menus with stages to visually display the discussions (see below for a preview)!
 Meeple Customization! Decide what any of the named characters looks like, from your closest allies and family members to your sworn nemesis.
 Cinematic moments putting you right in the middle of big moments!
 Vastly improved camera controls!
 Large number of new visual assets and expanded map!
 And more! (honestly, so many little improvements that I forget all that has changed.)


Thank you to everybody that has helped make this a reality and I can't wait for you all to see how far the game has come!

-SugoiPenguin Gaming (aka your liege lord, aka Addison)
